script.say: Thanks for joining. Today we are reviewing the Q3 budget before the board meeting.
Marketing spend went up twelve percent, mostly from the conference sponsorship in August.
Was that sponsorship planned, or did it come out of the contingency fund?
It came out of contingency. We had about forty thousand dollars left there.

script.text: Q3 Revenue: $4.2M (+8% QoQ). Top segment: Enterprise.

script.say: On revenue, we closed at four point two million, up eight percent from last quarter.
Enterprise carried most of that. Self serve was flat.
Sorry I am late. Did we already decide anything about hiring?
Not yet. Let's discuss hiring now. We want two backend engineers in Q4.
I can cover one of those roles from my team's budget if marketing gives back ten thousand.
That works. Marketing will return ten thousand to contingency.
Action items: Bob updates the marketing forecast, Rishi opens the backend job posting. Thanks everyone.

checks.ask: What happened in the first minute?
